Title: EP-1 Outlook Support Classification & KB Validation (Azure AI Foundry)
Description: Stateless classification agent (V2 consolidated) plus downstream KB-validation post-processing including the ask_user input-collection flow. Shipped as Azure Functions (Python v1, flat folders); Managed Identity auth only, no keys.

Title: F1 Consolidated Classification Agent
Description: Single-deployment classification agent (classification_agent_foundry/) with in-process KB search, one endpoint, one config.
Acceptance Criteria: Combined single deployment operational with route outlook-classification and request param 'message'.

Title: US-101 Single-deployment agent endpoint
Description: As the calling application I want one outlook-classification endpoint accepting a 'message' so I can classify without HTTP loopbacks.
Acceptance Criteria:
Single __init__.py, one route, one config; in-process KB search (no HTTP tool call).
AIProjectClient(endpoint, credential, allow_preview=True) -> get_openai_client() -> responses.create(...) pattern; conv_id via conversations.create().
Reads output_text and usage.input_tokens/output_tokens.

Title: US-102 Agent search loop (Approach B)
Description: As the agent I want to emit status:search plus a query and receive KB candidates, looping until follow_up/resolved/no_match.
Acceptance Criteria:
Search query is INTERNAL and never surfaced to the user.
Loop budget ~6; clean termination on each terminal status.

Title: US-103 Anti-hallucination KB id validation
Description: As a maintainer I want resolved kb_id values validated against the full index so fabricated ids are rejected.
Acceptance Criteria: Resolved kb_id validated against the whole index (is_known_kb_id); fabricated ids rejected.

Title: US-104 DSET coding standard and structured logging
Description: As a maintainer I want all Python to follow the DSET standard with structured logging and resilient remote calls.
Acceptance Criteria:
Header/section banners, full type hints, Pydantic at boundaries, f-strings.
Specific-exception try/except -> correlation_id JSON logging -> safe fallback (no leaked exceptions).
Exponential-backoff retry + timeouts + cost tracking on all model calls.

Title: US-105 Unique module names (flat-folder collision guard)
Description: As a maintainer I want unique module names per function folder to prevent sys.modules cross-loading.
Acceptance Criteria: No shared module names (e.g. config_loader, schemas) across folders; verified no wrong-module load in shared process.

Title: F2 Base KB Validation Service
Description: Base non-interactive KB-validation post-processing service (clasification_agent_validation/) with route kb-validation, Blob-sourced manual articles.
Acceptance Criteria: kb-validation endpoint returns the base response contract and formats manual steps via GPT-5.

Title: US-106 Validation endpoint and response contract
Description: As the caller I want POST kb-validation with {conv_id?, kb_id?} returning the base validation response.
Acceptance Criteria:
Response contains conv_id, kb_id, action, validated, steps, reference_link, agent_message.
Dictionary maps kb_id -> automate / manual / [automatic, ask_user].
validated=false only for not-found; true otherwise.

Title: US-107 Manual KB Blob read and GPT-5 step formatting
Description: As the service I want to read a manual KB article from Blob and format its steps with a stateless GPT-5 call.
Acceptance Criteria:
Reads KB article from Blob Storage; stateless GPT-5 formats steps (omit temperature).
success=false only on read/format exception; grounding-withhold is success=true.

Title: US-108 User-delegation SAS reference links
Description: As the service I want MI-based time-limited Blob links via a user-delegation SAS.
Acceptance Criteria: Uses get_user_delegation_key + generate_blob_sas(user_delegation_key=...); link is MI-based and time-limited.

Title: US-109 MI roles provisioning (base)
Description: As an operator I want the required Managed Identity roles requested by name for the base validation service.
Acceptance Criteria: Azure AI User + Cognitive Services OpenAI User + Storage Blob Data Reader + Storage Blob Delegator documented and requested by name (no keys).

Title: F3 Validation plus ask_user
Description: Interactive validation service (clasification_agent_validation_user_input/) with the ask_user user-input-collection flow and 6 anti-hallucination/security guards.
Acceptance Criteria: ask_user flow resolves PowerShell script parameters with a stateless GPT-5 reasoner and enforces all guards.

Title: US-201 ask_user reasoner and param resolution
Description: As the service I want a stateless GPT-5 reasoner to decide if input is needed and resolve it to exact PowerShell params.
Acceptance Criteria:
Reads bundled local .docx (kb_articles/) via python-docx - NOT Blob.
Reads Foundry history via conversations.items.list(conversation_id=...).
Response adds call_troubleshoot, follow_up_question, user_params, follup_flag, script_params, script_name, success, error.

Title: US-202 Multi-turn follow-up loop and internal loop guard
Description: As the service I want a stateless multi-turn follow-up loop bounded by an internal guard.
Acceptance Criteria:
Answer sent in 'message' (blank/omit on first turn); caller sends no counter.
Reasoner reports follow_up_rounds; give-up at foundry.max_follow_ups (default 3) -> validated=false, call_troubleshoot=false, success=true.
follow_up_rounds=0 on first ask_user turn so guard cannot trip early.

Title: US-203 auto_create_thread self-test write-back
Description: As a tester I want optional Foundry write-back so multi-turn ask_user collection accumulates during manual/Postman testing.
Acceptance Criteria:
auto_create_thread=true -> best-effort FoundryConversationReader.append_turn (gated, never fatal).
auto_create_thread=false in production (read-only, no double writes).

Title: US-204 Six anti-hallucination and security guards
Description: As a security owner I want all six guards enforced so no unvalidated or fabricated value reaches the PowerShell executor.
Acceptance Criteria:
(1) Provenance - collected value backed by verbatim transcript quote verified in code.
(2) Never-guess prompt rule.
(3) Confirm turn before finalizing.
(4) Collect only allowed fields (ask_user_fields.json).
(5) Step-verifier drops manual steps not grounded in the article.
(6) Parameter safety - allowed_values are format examples only; every resolved value bounded + metacharacter-free + grounded; defaults pass same gate; downstream PowerShell uses bound/named params (no Invoke-Expression).

Title: US-205 Response-contract edge cases
Description: As the caller I want the interactive flags set correctly across ask_user turns.
Acceptance Criteria:
call_troubleshoot=true only on FINAL ask_user turn, null on follow-ups, false otherwise.
user_params/follup_flag true only on ask_user path (follup_flag true while asking, false when ready).
script_params/script_name set only on the FINAL turn of a spec KB (from ask_user_params.json).

Title: F4 Supporting Tooling and Provisioning
Description: Article-download sibling function, ask_user_params generator tool, and Managed Identity provisioning for the interactive service.
Acceptance Criteria: kb-article function serves bundled docx; ask_user_params.json entries generated; MI roles requested by name.

Title: US-206 kb_article_download anonymous serving function
Description: As the service I want a sibling function to serve the bundled <kb_id>.docx over HTTP so reference_link is a clickable URL.
Acceptance Criteria: Route kb-article, anonymous auth; serves only kb_ids published in validation.json; path-traversal safe.

Title: US-207 ask_user_params generator tool
Description: As a maintainer I want a tool to generate ask_user_params.json from KB content and its PowerShell script.
Acceptance Criteria: GPT-5-mini reads the KB .docx + PowerShell script and generates ask_user_params.json entries (script_name is bare .ps1).

Title: US-208 MI roles (user_input) and README
Description: As an operator I want the correct MI roles requested and the file-by-file flow documented.
Acceptance Criteria:
Cognitive Services OpenAI User (GPT-5) + Azure AI User (conversation read) on the Foundry project.
Conversation WRITE only if auto_create_thread=true; no Storage roles.
File-by-file flow documented in README.md.
